title.narrative: Green Cities 2 W2 E2 - Lviv Wastewater Project

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to €10 million (the "Loan") to Lviv City Communal Enterprise "Lvivvodokanal" (the "Company") to finance a critical rehabilitation and modernization of two Wastewater Treatment Plants ("WWTPs") in the City of Lviv. The Loan is planned to be co-financed by a €6.5 million investment grant from the Eastern Europe Energy Efficiency and Environment Partnership ("E5P"). Given war-triggered risks related to vulnerability of the energy infrastructure, which remains a primary target of Russian missile attacks across Ukraine, the Loan will benefit from a partial guarantee provided by the Government of Spain on a pari passu basis. The Project is a part of the broader investment programme, encompassing rehabilitation of the Lviv WWTPs, which is expected to be co-financed by NEFCO and Danida Sustainable Infrastructure Finance. The project is part of the Green City Framework 2 Window II - Extension 2 (" GrCF2"). The Project is a follow-on investment stemming from Lviv Green City Action Plan ("GCAP"). The Project aims to ensure sustainable operation of the WWTPs units and permanently improve the quality of the treated effluent returned to the Poltva River, a tributary of Bug, the Vistula River drainage basin. The Project will also ensure sustainable operation of the new biogas facilities, being constructed under the on-going Lviv wastewater biogas project and improve the Company's operational and financial performance and capacity.
